run_generate_samples: run generate_samples to create flyaround videos from a trained HoloDiffusion model checkpoint
run_generate_samples_custom_trajectory: run generate_samples with a spiral camera path and 40 evaluation cameras
run_generate_samples_denoising: run generate_samples with progressive denoising steps enabled to render denoising animations
run_generate_samples_custom_output: run generate_samples with a custom output directory and video resolution of 512x512
run_generate_samples_minimal: run generate_samples with default settings using only the experiment directory path
